message: I have a friend who, bless her heart, is always the first to panic when she hears about a storm brewing. The other day, she called me in a frenzy, asking if I had my go-bag ready. It made me chuckle, but it also reminded me of the importance of being prepared without the stress. So, I took a moment to double-check my family's water supply and emergency documents, just to keep the peace of mind flowing. It's all about balance, right? How do you keep your readiness calm and collected?
